title: Strength Predictive Modelling of Soils Treated with Calcium-Based Additives Blended with Eco-Friendly Pozzolans-A Machine Learning Approach
summary: On 392 literature-compiled stabilized-soil samples, the study reports classification accuracy of 0.920 and regression R² around 0.900. Evaluation used cross-validation and a held-out split from the compiled data; independent experimental or field validation is not reported.
ai_technology: Gradient-boosting models map stabilizer/pozzolan composition and curing inputs to unconfined soil-strength values and classes.
